The rooms hold anywhere from 5 to 100 persons. Events can be held any day of the week, although they are typically scheduled Friday through Sunday to coincide with our featured races. services.desc: Raceway Park has hundreds of diverse acres with a wide array of different backdrops and spaces for many different activities. Our stadium area has 17,000 numbered grandstand seats and 3 acres of “floor” space. The facility also has 14 acres of paved parking lot space and 60 acres of grass parking/event space to be used in any way imaginable! Whether you are looking for a space to shoot action scenes that involve driving or stunts, or need a racetrack backdrop for a photo shoot we have what you need!
